skills.name: adversarial-verification
skills.description: Assigns independent agents to try to refute a claim and its evidence and returns a verdict with the part that survives, when the user or another skill calls for an adversarial review or fact-check of a numeric, legal, novelty or prior-art claim.

skills.name: agent-security-scan
skills.description: Scans the assistant's settings, hooks, skills, Model Context Protocol config and credential files for exposed secrets, remote fetches and side-effecting shell commands, after any of them changes or governance rules from another project are adopted, or when the user asks to check them.

skills.name: boundary-contract
skills.description: Writes a boundary contract listing the work's objective, allowed and prohibited paths and actions, acceptance criteria, phase and stop conditions, when task-router requires one.

skills.name: brainstorming
skills.description: Resolves open design decisions, including expected behavior, with the user and writes the accepted design before implementation.

skills.name: compact-handoff
skills.description: Writes a handoff of the task's objective, scope, evidence and next action when a long conversation, compaction or handover to another session or agent could lose them, and resumes the task from it afterwards.

skills.name: dispatching-parallel-agents
skills.description: Delegates two or more tasks to parallel agents and combines their outputs, when no task edits a file another task reads or edits, no two share mutable state or an exclusive resource, and none needs another's output.

skills.name: executing-plans
skills.description: Executes an accepted plan with the assistant doing every task itself, when inline execution is chosen.

skills.name: finishing-a-development-branch
skills.description: For a branch ready to integrate, runs its locally runnable CI jobs before any push or merge and carries out the user's choice, asking if undecided: merge locally, open or merge a pull request, keep, or delete the branch.

skills.name: merge-companion
skills.description: Reviews the user's backed-up edits to installed skills and merges each into the new skill version, discards or defers it as the user chooses, before a task changes or reinstalls an installed skill, or when the user asks for that review.

skills.name: necessity-gate
skills.description: Approves, rescopes or rejects new work (a task, follow-up, skill, file, tool, audit or verification cycle, or skill edit) when the assistant proposes it or the user asks whether to do it.

skills.name: receiving-code-review
skills.description: When code review findings arrive, judges each against the requirements, code and tests before changing code, then fixes valid ones, rejects incorrect ones with evidence and reports the rest as unresolved.

skills.name: requesting-code-review
skills.description: Dispatches the code-reviewer subagent after a major feature is built or before a merge into main, and checks that a pull request's reviews finished and CI passed on its latest commit before merging it.

skills.name: session-intent-analyzer
skills.description: Records the assistant's new or changed interpretation of a request before the first tool call of work, and reads the stored interpretation when it can change the objective, constraints, work choice or whether earlier work continues.

skills.name: skill-evolution
skills.description: Recommends skill changes from recorded tool-call patterns and corrections of the assistant's behavior, when the user asks for such recommendations or their pending backlog, or authorizes that analysis.

skills.name: subagent-driven-development
skills.description: Executes an accepted plan in this session by giving each task, one at a time, to a new subagent and reviewing the result, when the user chose subagent execution and each task is self-contained.

skills.name: systematic-debugging
skills.description: Before a fix is proposed for a failure with an unclear cause, tests hypotheses, fixes the supported cause and counts failed fix attempts, reassessing the hypothesis after five.

skills.name: task-router
skills.description: Selects the work, skills, acceptance criteria and boundary contract for a request that needs or may need a tool to change, run, analyze or verify something, or to read a remote source.

skills.name: test-driven-development
skills.description: Writes a failing test before the code that makes it pass, for a feature or bug fix whose expected behavior is known and testable through the production code.

skills.name: using-coding-convention
skills.description: Before each step of development work (file read, command, edit, plan or review), loads the coding-convention skill that fits it, such as writing-plans or test-driven-development.

skills.name: using-git-worktrees
skills.description: Reuses or creates a git worktree when an authorized development task must run separately from the current checkout.

skills.name: verification-before-completion
skills.description: Before a new completion, working-fix, success or verified-status claim or a recommendation the user will act on, checks it against its criterion and evidence and decides whether evidence must be reread.

skills.name: writing-plans
skills.description: Writes an implementation plan that breaks accepted requirements into tasks a newcomer to the project can carry out, after design decisions are settled and before implementation.

skills.name: writing-skills
skills.description: Writes a new skill or changes an existing one in its folder (SKILL.md, references and scripts) and tests it.
